Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "image/png", uri: "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"element_config\":{\"include_elements\":true,\"min_level\":\"word\"},\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"]}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).ocr_elements)
```
